parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are returned
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置。

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule that matches the specified name
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

Ciphersuite.description_en: The custom cipher suite, which specifies the encryption algorithms selected when CiphersuiteGroup is set to custom
Ciphersuite.description_zh: 自定义加密套件，表示当CiphersuiteGroup为custom时选取的具体加密算法

CiphersuiteGroup.description_en:
The cipher suite group. All cipher suites are enabled by default. Valid values:
all: all cipher suites.
strict: strong cipher suites.
custom: custom cipher suites
CiphersuiteGroup.description_zh:
加密套件组，默认使能全部加密套件。取值范围：
all：全部加密套件。
strict：强加密套件。
custom：自定义加密套件

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：

global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置

Http2.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/2. HTTP/2 is enabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Http2.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP2，默认开启。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Http3.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP/3. HTTP/3 is enabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Http3.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP3，默认开启。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Https.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTPS. HTTPS is enabled by default. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
Https.description_zh:
是否开启HTTPS，默认开启。取值范围：

on：开启。

off：关闭

OcspStapling.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable OCSP stapling. OCSP stapling is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
OcspStapling.description_zh:
是否开启OCSP，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

Tls10.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS 1.0. TLS 1.0 is disabled by default. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
Tls10.description_zh:
是否开启TLS1.0，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

off: disabled
Tls11.description_zh:
是否开启TLS1.1，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Tls12.description_en:

是否开启TLS1.3，默认关闭。取值范围：

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
